verdict.rationale: The MI355X ships with a substantial software stack (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Container Toolkit), so asking whether vendor telemetry or usage tracking can be disabled is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains nothing about vendor telemetry or opt-out controls. Device Metrics Exporter and Omnistat are user-operated local monitoring tools, not vendor usage tracking, so they earn no credit as adjacent features.
